name: Hobab
description: Midianite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: Moses said unto Hobab the son of Raguel the Midianite, his kinsman by marriage, we are journeying unto the place of which the Lord said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good. Hobab answered that he would depart to his own land and to his kindred, to go back to his people.

note.label: Numbers 10: The Silver Trumpets and the Order of the Journeys

points: Barak calls Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh and goes up with ten thousand men at his feet, and Deborah goes up with him. Heber the Kenite, of the children of Hobab the father in law of Moses, had severed himself from the Kenites and pitched his tent by Kedesh.
